newsitem.title: USA: Zapata begins tender for up to 15 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Zapata begins tender for up to 15 mln shares.

text.p: Zapata Corp said it has begun a cash tender offer for up to 15 million shares of its common stock at a price of $4.50 per share.
It said the offer will be made on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in its definitive tender offer materials, which are being mailed to stockholders today.
The tender offer will expire at 1700 EST/2200 GMT on February 20, unless extended.

The offer is conditioned upon a minimum of 10 million shares being validly tendered and not withdrawn prior to expiration and also is subject to certain other conditions set forth in the offer materials.
Zapata has approximately 29.5 million shares of common stock outstanding.
